title: concepts reply
description: What the concept model returns for one batch of claims (corpuslm.concepts): the concept labels each claim uses, by the claim's index in the batch.

claims.description: One entry per claim of the batch.

index.description: The claim's index in the batch, as given.

concepts.description: Labels of the concepts the claim uses; may be empty.

items.description: A short lowercase noun phrase naming one concept.
